$comment: Manual facts for scripts/generateThirdPartyLicenses.js (#627). Keys are name@version. Overrides may only supply facts verifiable inside the installed package: a license expression when package.json declares none (with licenseEvidence), verbatim excerpts from package files when no LICENSE file is shipped (noticeExcerpts), an explicit statement that no license text is shipped (noLicenseText), and notes. upstreamLicenseFiles points to an upstream license file stored verbatim in scripts/thirdPartyLicenses/ (file name prefixed with name@version) for packages whose published tarball ships none; source and provenance record where it was taken from. Overrides never replace a declared license expression.
